points.text: Reference-then-copy mechanism untested; no probing or control for extra tokens.
Resolution generalization confounded with domain shift; no resolution sweep.
Flat results across interval s conflict with bounded-arithmetic explanation.
Single runs, no variance; most gains within sampling noise; 'significant' untested.
Headline gain measured against different model rather than matched baseline.
Baseline provenance (copied vs reproduced) unclear.
Claim of less training data than GUI-Actor not quantified.
I-MRoPE evaluated only in weak from-scratch setting; gains may reflect adaptation ease.
Lower training-loss claim for I-MRoPE has no reported values.
Efficiency evidence is token counts only; no latency or FLOPs.
'Less than 1%' overhead claim omits mobile 2.8% case.
Setting notation p and tokenization of RULER values undefined.
Own rows use unweighted averages while baselines are sample-weighted.
Eq. 8 uses t where w intended.
LLaVA-558K citation inconsistent.
Typo, ambiguous count phrasing, stray dagger.
Mechanism untested; no extra-token controls; flat s response.
Resolution claim confounded with domain shift; no resolution-controlled experiment.
Headline uses wrong baseline (31.1 instead of 34.6).
'Consistent gains' contradicted by decreases in sub-columns.
I-MRoPE near-duplicate of Qwen3-VL; 'previously overlooked' too strong; VideoRoPE uncited.
I-MRoPE gains at most 0.5 and not evaluated in fine-tuned setting.
Single runs, no CIs; deltas within one SE.
Overgeneralized reliability claims: no agent task, web-only training, two backbones.
Inconsistent averaging between own and baseline rows.
Notation and citation inconsistencies.
Overhead claim omits mobile worst case; no latency.
Private correspondence cited in blinded submission.
Pixel budget implausible for 4K; evaluation resolution not stated.
I-MRoPE not positioned against prior RoPE work; 'previously overlooked' too strong.
RULER not related to set-of-mark, Pix2Seq or region-token precedents.
No same-data comparison with visible grid overlay or label-smoothing baselines.
Resolution-aware, zoom and RL grounding methods not engaged; composition untested.
Citation names inconsistent with bibliography.
Related work reads as a list.
Real-world resolution diversity argued but no resolution or scaling test.
Coordinate-frame and resizing assumptions unstated; anisotropic and multi-image untested.
Claim of applications beyond GUI unsupported.
No broader-impact or safety discussion.
Latency on real GPU not reported.
No qualitative failure cases shown.
I-MRoPE gains tiny and unused in strongest setting.
Headline overstated; compares against non-matched baseline.
Training/inference format, tokenization, placement and t0 ambiguous.
No qualitative results, failure analysis or limitations.
Stronger baselines outperform; data-limitation explanation untested; no matched-data comparison.
RL and zoom-based methods only mentioned in related work.
Typos and spacing.
Underperforms UI-TARS and GUI-Actor; training-data explanation insufficient.
Core idea a variation of explicit coordinate tokens from prior work.
No attention probing showing reference-and-adjust mechanism is learned.
Unspecified further questions.
New tokens and encoding add architectural complexity and resources.
Performance may depend on training data quality and diversity.
Possible overfitting to specific tasks or resolutions.
Generalization to grounding tasks beyond GUI unclear.
No evaluation on GUI agent tasks like AndroidWorld or WebArena.
Effect on general VLM abilities not tested.
Fails to match GUI-Actor on similar problem.
ScreenSpot comparisons lack recent strong baselines.
Motivation weak; I-MRoPE rationale under-developed.
Results not situated within latest leaderboard trends.
No investigation of why other methods outperform.
Limited range of MLLM foundation models evaluated.
I-MRoPE contribution marginal; combining methods unjustified.
No interpretability analysis such as attention or heatmaps.
No downstream GUI agent task evaluation.
No scaling analysis over model size and data.
Needs step-by-step case study of workflow.
Computational implications such as inference latency not analysed.
Advantage over OCR locations plus CoT layout analysis unclear.

Limited novelty vs explicit coordinate tokens.
